answer: Sybil defense runs along one commitment thread: a new agent may only join after a graded peer on the trust mesa vouches with a signed parent hash. Inside that voucher sits a walnut of nested proofs—prior score, stake epoch, and a fresh nonce—so forging a thousand clones means either waiting for each fake identity to climb the same mesa or inventing parents graders discard. Honest agents reuse one thread; attackers burn time and capital per clone.
